cosmos3_nano_fixed_observation_gate.result: Repeat LEFT actions and 33-frame RGB futures were bit-identical; exact LEFT and RIGHT prompts produced distinct finite [32,8] actions and distinct futures.
cosmos3_nano_fixed_observation_gate.denominator_policy: The three fixed-observation action requests are diagnostic interface evidence only and contribute zero behavioral episodes.

action_s1_overlay_equivalence.result: All three returned actions and retained latent futures were bit-exact against the archived official V2-A007 fixed-observation probe; repeat LEFT was also bit-exact and LEFT versus RIGHT remained action- and future-distinct.

action_s2_release.result: Repeat LEFT actions and latent futures were bit-exact; LEFT and RIGHT actions differed; all returned actions were finite [24,8] tensors; all retained latent futures were finite; and the scale-2 outputs differed from the scale-1 overlay as expected.

dreamzero_fixed_observation_gates.denominator_policy: The six fixed-observation action requests and all setup-invalid attempts are diagnostic infrastructure evidence only. They contribute zero behavioral episodes and are excluded from every model-success denominator.

cosmos3_nano_behavioral_arm.claim_boundary: Relative to the preserved g=3 baseline, g=1 lost two LEFT successes and no RIGHT successes. This is a descriptive reduction in directional balance and robustness in a six-cell post-result pilot, not a powered or general claim and not evidence that CFG caused either individual failure.

dreamzero_behavioral_arm.claim_boundary: The observed total changed from 3/6 at s=1-equivalent to 4/6 at s=2, while directional success redistributed from LEFT 2/3 and RIGHT 1/3 to LEFT 1/3 and RIGHT 3/3. This six-cell post-result pilot is descriptive and is not a powered improvement claim.

next_gate: No V2-A015 behavioral cell remains. Do not rerun either arm; compile and hash-bind the Cosmos3 Nano g=1 raw evidence before making trajectory-quality claims, then build the comparison media and keep both six-cell denominators separate.
